title: Vero Beach Equestrian Club
specs: 60-acre property with multiple riding arenas including covered arena
Diverse Florida wildlife visible on trails including deer, armadillos, herons, butterflies
All independent trail riders must be at least 10 years old; younger riders get one-on-one trainer
Riders must wear helmets, long pants, and closed toe shoes for trail rides
Negative coggins test and signed release required for outside riders bringing their own horse
If a trainer accompanies outside rider, proof of insurance required
Group trail rides for 1 to 4 people
Summer camp limit 6 campers per instructor, max 15 riders

blurb: Guests can take English and Western riding lessons from beginner to advanced levels, including private and group lessons. The club offers group trail rides on a 60-acre property with diverse Florida wildlife. They also host summer camps for children, horse shows, and provide their property for film and commercial production rentals.
